event.title: rekursiv.ai announced its public launch
event.summary: rekursiv.ai announced it was launching #Ray2, our brand new video model to everyone.

sourcePreview.title: Today we're launching #Ray2, our brand new video model to everyone. Excited to see what you all create with this, it was a blast to play around with the model and see so many of my generations look this good.
